enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Armor-Piercing 14%: Passive: +14% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)

Corrosive Salt: This weapon stores a caustic, insatiable power deep within. When this weapon is used, this power can come to the surface in the form of a noxious, corrosive salt that dissolves all substances.
Chilling 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 4d6 Ice damage on each hit.
Freezing 10: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 10 to 60 Ice damage on each critical hit.
